zh-CN.title: 星空背景动效放缓
items: 进一步降低星空旋涡与云层的移动速度，让聊天背景更舒缓
保留不同星层的速度差和方向，减少持续运动带来的视觉干扰

en.title: Slower starry background motion
items: Further slowed the starry vortices and drifting clouds for a calmer chat background
Preserved subtle speed and direction differences while reducing visual distraction
